Tara V.: Heads-up: partner asks for an "orchestration compat" checklist that maps LangChain/LlamaIndex connectors -> our Gateway adapter -> Redwood runtime. Need that before partner preview next week.
Lee J.: We should include explicit tests: end-to-end sample, failure injection (quota drop), and telemetry naming. Keep tests <15m to be partner-run.
Maya R.: I'll draft a compatibility matrix: LangChain versions, LlamaIndex connector versions, supported model variants, quantization notes, and recommended SDK pins.
Grant S.: Also add an orchestration note: recommended worker counts, batch sizing, and CV (cold-start) mitigation. Example: for H100, start with replicas:2 and batchSize:8.
OpsBot: Reminder: avoid pushing infra changes during Thu 04:00-06:00 UTC maintenance.
Tara V.: Marketplace needs short blurb for the listing that includes supported orchestrators (LangChain, LlamaIndex, OrchestratorX) and a trial SKU. Todd, constraints?
Marketplace-Todd: SKU must be <=60 chars, no slashes. Use "Gateway-Bridge-LangChain-Partner-Beta-[partner]" pattern. We'll set visibility to partner-only until conformance tests pass.
Maya R.: Conformance tests to include: 1) sample manifest deploy, 2) smoke script hitting /attach and /route, 3) load-lite 200 qps for 60s, 4) fallback path when GPU unavailable. I'll write runbook snippets.
Grant S.: For fallback we should provide a policy snippet and a telemetry event emitted when fallback triggers (adapter.fallback.triggered). SI dashboards rely on that.
Legal (Elena): Co-mark copy ready. If partner wants "powered by", need signed endorsement form. Default language: "integrated with Redwood Inference".
Tara V.: Action owners: Maya: compat matrix + runbook. Lee: short smoke scripts + test harness. Grant: perf guidance + fallback policy. Todd: hold marketplace draft until we sign off conformance. Elena: co-mark signoff path.
Lee J.: I'll add a GitHub Actions CI job sample to run the conformance tests and fail if any test returns non-2xx.
Maya R.: Timeline: deliver artifacts by Mon EOD. Partner rehearsal Tue. Public partner-preview Wed if all green.
OpsBot: If conformance tests fail on fallback path, automatic rollback to partner-only listing will occur.
Tara V.: Cool. We'll also capture a short FAQ for partners about Dedicated vs Private (networking and KMS notes).
Marketplace-Todd: Noted. I'll keep the draft listing in partner-drafts/330000 until we signal green.
Grant S.: Uploading perf samples and a short script to measure p95 for template prompts.
Tara V.: Thanks team. Close loop once matrix + runbook posted. End thread.
